packageRules.description: Group AGP (with built-in Kotlin), Kotlin/Compose compiler plugins, KSP, and Gradle wrapper together

Pin AGP to 9.1.x. Google AI Studio's Play publishing container runs pre-installed Gradle 9.3.1 (ignoring gradle-wrapper.properties, observed via `gradle --version` and AGP 9.5.0 failure 'Minimum supported Gradle version is 9.6.0. Current version is 9.3.1.'). No public AI Studio URL documents this container pin; AGP 9.2+ requires Gradle 9.4+ per https://developer.android.com/build/releases/gradle-plugin

Pin Gradle wrapper to 9.3.x to match Google AI Studio's pre-installed Gradle 9.3.1 build/publish runtime (no public AI Studio URL documents the container version; AGP 9.1's Gradle 9.3.1 requirement is documented at https://developer.android.com/build/releases/gradle-plugin).
Group Jetpack Compose BOM, Compose libraries, and Activity Compose

Pin Compose BOM below 2026.08.00. Google AI Studio's build/publishing container only has android-36 and android-36.1 installed in $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/platforms (no android-37), and Compose BOM 2026.08.00+ requires compileSdk 37.
Pin Activity Compose to <= 1.13.x while AI Studio's container lacks android-37 SDK (1.14+ targets compileSdk 37).
Pin AndroidX Core KTX below 1.19.0 while AI Studio's container only has android-36/36.1 installed (core-ktx 1.19+ requires compileSdk 37).
Pin AndroidX Lifecycle below 2.11.0 while AI Studio's container only has android-36/36.1 installed (lifecycle 2.11.0+ AAR metadata requires compileSdk 37).
Pin OkHttp to 4.x. OkHttp 5.5.0+ (okhttp-android) requires compileSdk 37 (missing in AI Studio's android-36/36.1 container), and coil-compose 2.7.0 is compiled against OkHttp 4.x.
Group Coil artifacts together (covers Coil 2 and Coil 3 modules)
Group unit and AndroidX testing libraries together
Group GitHub Actions workflow dependencies together
